c1_0_substrate_contract.description: C1.0 substrate contract locked after CORRECTION.1, CORRECTION.2, and CORRECTION.3 passes. Substrate ownership is @cline/agents; cross-package contracts live in @cline/shared. Two distinct family latches: budgetExhausted (set on the third observation; gates isExactBlocked / isFamilyBlocked; visible state = warning) and circuitTripped (set only by recordBlockedAttempt; visible state = circuit_open). Pre-execution exact breaker is family-independent (isExactBlocked(attemptKey), markExactBlocked(attemptKey)). Post-execution family convergence via recordFailure(family, exactKey, fingerprint). recordBlockedAttempt(attemptKey) re-anchors activeFamily to the resolved owner and uses the SAME predicate as isExactBlocked (budgetExhausted && owns(attemptKey)). Model-facing notice is once-per-episode. Identity uses FNV-1a 32-bit diagnostic projection (browser-compatible, no node:crypto). The two-track privacy contract is enforced through typed-identity overloads (recordFailureIdentity, etc.) which store unbounded canonical control identities internally and project to diagnostic IDs on snapshot/event emission.

c1_0_fixes_applied: Single source of circuit truth via two distinct family latches (`budgetExhausted`, `circuitTripped`). State, isFamilyBlocked, getBlockedFamilies, snapshot all read these same latches.
Multi-family episode retention — families map within an episode survives family hops.
State-transition event capture-before-mutate — idle→recovering, recovering→warning, warning→circuit_open all fire reliably; same-state emits nothing.
Warning contract fixed — DEFAULT_RECOVERY_POLICY = { maxRepairAttempts: 2, warningThreshold: 2 }; visible state is `warning` while `budgetExhausted = true && circuitTripped = false`.

Strong deterministic fingerprint — FNV-1a 32-bit projected to 8-char lowercase hex (browser-compatible, no node:crypto dependency). Two-track identity: control identity (canonical) is package-private; diagnostic identity (8-char hex) is the only public surface. Substrate owner is @cline/agents; contract types live in @cline/shared.
Structured-classifier-first — extractStableFailureCode is a fallback (boundary-anchored tokens, prefers err.code over message scanning).
Invariant matrix contract — 5-table it.each covering no episode, 1/2/3/4-failure walks under default policy.

CORRECTION.1: isExactBlocked(attemptKey) is family-independent; original failure does NOT globally block the exact key; repairAttempts = post-original-failure failures only; recordToolSuccess requires toolName match; C1.3-shaped integration fixture.
CORRECTION.2: added recordBlockedAttempt(attemptKey); renamed circuitOpened → budgetExhausted and added circuitTripped; circuitNoticeCount no longer increments on recordFailure.

CORRECTION.3: recordBlockedAttempt re-anchors activeFamily to the resolved owner BEFORE deriving canonical state. The block resolver (`blockedFamilyForAttemptKey`) uses the SAME predicate as isExactBlocked (`budgetExhausted && owns(attemptKey)`), so a key seen by multiple families is attributed to the exhausted owner only. The markExactBlocked fallback is dropped — blocks with no owning family are no-ops. Added `failureFamily` to RecoveryStateChangeEvent. Circuit notice policy documented as once-per-episode (model-facing notification budget, not per-family).
Stale comments fixed: top-level API reference is now `isExactBlocked(attemptKey)`; warning JSDoc rewritten to reflect 'budget consumed; next attempt must be intercepted at pre-execution'.

c1_0_post_correction_strict: Privacy contract is unconditional: legacy string overloads (recordFailureControl, isExactBlockedControl, markExactBlockedControl, recordBlockedAttemptControl) are PRIVATE; the public API is the typed-identity overloads (recordFailureIdentity, isExactBlockedIdentity, markExactBlockedIdentity, recordBlockedAttemptIdentity).

Snapshot/event projection is unconditional: every emitted identifier passes through controlKeyToDiagnosticId / controlFamilyToDiagnosticId, so the public surface is always opaque hex regardless of which overload was used.
attemptDiagnosticId and familyDiagnosticId delegate to createAttemptIdentity / createFamilyIdentity; the canonical encoding convention is defined in exactly one place.
